candidates.name: Practice guide 42: upgrading the class of title
verified_facts: HM Land Registry distinguishes classes of registered title and requires evidence to upgrade an inferior class.
An upgrade depends on remedying the reason the inferior class was granted and HM Land Registry examining supporting evidence.
semantic_limits: Class-of-title quality is legal registration status; it does not provide surveyed boundary coordinates or terrain elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: Return and rejection of applications for registration (practice guide 49)
verified_facts: HM Land Registry may reject substantially defective applications.
For dealings of part, applications can be rejected where the land extent cannot be identified or related to the Ordnance Survey map.
semantic_limits: Registration acceptance or rejection is a geometry-identifiability quality gate, not an elevation measurement or accuracy certificate.
